cancelModal.messageConfirmed: The order is closed and any stock it holds is released.
cancelModal.messageDraft: The draft is closed. It holds no stock, so nothing is released.

completeModal.message: The order is closed and whatever it still holds is released back to stock.
completeModal.nothingLeft: Every line has been delivered through notes — nothing is left to take.
completeModal.reduceHint: For goods that shipped without a delivery note for everything. What the notes already took is not taken again.
completeModal.reduceToggle: Also take the undelivered remainder out of stock
completeModal.title: Complete this order?

confirmModal.message: Stock for every line is locked against this order. It is not deducted — the delivery note does that.
confirmModal.title: Confirm this order?

deliveryNotes.hint: An order cannot go back to draft or be cancelled while a note stands against it. Cancel the notes first — or fulfil the order, if they have already shipped.
deliveryNotes.title: Delivery notes

fieldsInvalid.message: Custom fields are hidden until the configuration is fixed. Their stored values are untouched.
fieldsInvalid.title: Custom field configuration is invalid

flowInvalid.message: Status changes are disabled until the configuration is fixed. Records stay readable.
flowInvalid.title: Status flow configuration is invalid

form.copyingFrom: Copying from {{orderNumber}} — adjust and save as a new order.
form.customerPlaceholder: Search by name, code or phone
form.itemSearchPlaceholder: Search products by name or code to add a line
form.itemUnknown: Item no longer in the catalogue
form.noLines: Search above to add the first item.

lockModal.message: Stock for every line is locked against this order.
lockModal.title: Lock stock for this order?

releaseModal.message: The stock this order holds goes back to available. Nothing about the order changes.
releaseModal.title: Release this order's stock?

notFound.message: It may have been removed, or the link is out of date.
notFound.title: Order not found

notifications.confirmPartial: Order confirmed, but some stock is still to lock.
notifications.writeError: Could not save the order. Please try again.

payment.statusHint: What you state here is what the order says — a settled order with the rest written off is Paid.
payment.title: Payment
payment.unpriced: Price the order before recording a payment against it.
payment.warnExceedsTotal: That is more than the order total. Check it, or the excess is recorded as the customer’s credit.
payment.warnSettlesOrder: That covers the whole total — consider marking it Paid.
payment.warnWriteOff: Less than the order total. The remainder is recorded as written off.

pending.message: Some of this order's stock writes have not finished. Press Finish Posting to complete them — running it twice is safe.
pending.title: Inventory writes unfinished

remainderReduced.none: Completion asked for a deduction, but every line had shipped through notes, so nothing more was taken.
remainderReduced.title: Taken out of stock on completion

validation.customerRequired: Pick or type a customer name

field.option: Pick one of the offered values

validation.phoneInvalid: That is not a valid phone number
validation.quantityPositive: Quantity must be greater than zero
